accepted.name: session_level_base
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  visitId,
  fullVisitorId,
  CAST(visitorId AS STRING) AS visitor_id_string,
  userId,
  visitNumber,
  visitStartTime,
  PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', date) AS session_date,
  totals.visits AS totals_visits,
  totals.hits AS totals_hits,
  totals.pageviews AS totals_pageviews,
  totals.timeOnSite AS totals_time_on_site,
  totals.bounces AS totals_bounces,
  totals.transactions AS totals_transactions,
  totals.transactionRevenue AS totals_transaction_revenue,
  channelGrouping,
  trafficSource.source AS traffic_source,
  trafficSource.medium AS traffic_medium,
  trafficSource.campaign AS traffic_campaign,
  device.browser AS device_browser,
  device.deviceCategory AS device_category,
  geoNetwork.country AS geo_country,
  geoNetwork.region AS geo_region,
  geoNetwork.city AS geo_city,
  socialEngagementType
FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_20170127`
grain: visitId, fullVisitorId, visitStartTime (one row per session)
accepted.description: Session-level projection: one row per session exposing core identifiers, timestamp/date, traffic/device/geo attributes and top-level totals. Use this as the canonical session table before joins/unnests. | Use for: Aggregate sessions by date/device/geo/traffic source; Filter sessions for cohorts (by userId, country, device); Join to unnested hits or products using visitId/fullVisitorId

accepted.name: hits_flat
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  s.visitId,
  s.fullVisitorId,
  CAST(s.visitorId AS STRING) AS visitor_id_string,
  s.userId,
  s.visitStartTime,
  PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', s.date) AS session_date,
  hit.hitNumber AS hit_number,
  hit.type AS hit_type,
  hit.time AS hit_time_ms,
  hit.hour AS hit_hour,
  hit.minute AS hit_minute,
  hit.isEntrance AS is_entrance,
  hit.isExit AS is_exit,
  hit.page.pagePath AS page_path,
  hit.page.pageTitle AS page_title,
  hit.eventInfo.eventCategory AS event_category,
  hit.eventInfo.eventAction AS event_action,
  hit.eventInfo.eventLabel AS event_label,
  hit.eventInfo.eventValue AS event_value,
  hit.transaction.transactionId AS hit_transaction_id,
  hit.transaction.transactionRevenue AS hit_transaction_revenue,
  hit.item.itemQuantity AS hit_item_quantity,
  hit.item.itemRevenue AS hit_item_revenue
FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_20170127` AS s,
  UNNEST(s.hits) AS hit
grain: visitId, hitNumber (one row per hit within a session)
accepted.description: Flattened hit-level rows: one row per session-hit exposing hit attributes plus session identifiers and selected session-level context. Use when analyzing pageviews, events, or hit timing. Note: unnesting increases row count relative to sessions. | Use for: Count pageviews or events by page or event category; Analyze hit timing distributions within sessions; Join to session-level attributes for contextual hit analysis

accepted.name: sessions_by_user_rank
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  visitId,
  fullVisitorId,
  visitStartTime,
  PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', date) AS session_date,
  totals.transactionRevenue AS totals_transaction_revenue,
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY fullVisitorId ORDER BY visitStartTime DESC) AS rn_per_user,
  RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY fullVisitorId ORDER BY visitStartTime DESC) AS rnk_per_user
FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_20170127`
grain: visitId (one row per session, with rank columns per user)
accepted.description: Rank sessions per user by visitStartTime (most recent first) providing row_number and rank per fullVisitorId. Use to select latest session(s) per user downstream by filtering on row_number or rank. | Use for: Select the most recent session per user; Compare recent vs previous sessions per user; Limit analyses to top-N sessions per user

accepted.name: daily_aggregates_by_country_source
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', date) AS session_date,
  geoNetwork.country AS geo_country,
  trafficSource.source AS traffic_source,
  trafficSource.medium AS traffic_medium,
  COUNT(1) AS sessions_count,
  SUM(totals.pageviews) AS sum_pageviews,
  SUM(totals.hits) AS sum_hits,
  SUM(totals.transactionRevenue) AS sum_transaction_revenue,
  AVG(totals.timeOnSite) AS avg_time_on_site
FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_20170127`
GROUP BY session_date, geo_country, traffic_source, traffic_medium
grain: session_date, geo_country, traffic_source, traffic_medium (one row per day-country-source-medium)
accepted.description: Daily aggregated measures grouped by session_date, country and traffic source/medium: sessions count, total pageviews, total hits, total transaction revenue and average session duration. Use for time-series and breakdown analyses. | Use for: Time-series of sessions/pageviews/revenue by country or source; Compare source performance within a country on a given day; Feed aggregated metrics into dashboards or modeling

accepted.name: session_custom_dimensions_exploded
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  s.visitId,
  s.fullVisitorId,
  CAST(s.visitorId AS STRING) AS visitor_id_string,
  s.visitStartTime,
  PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', s.date) AS session_date,
  cd.index AS cd_index,
  cd.value AS cd_value
FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_20170127` AS s,
  UNNEST(s.customDimensions) AS cd
grain: visitId, cd_index (one row per custom dimension instance on a session)
accepted.description: Explode session-level customDimensions array into one row per custom dimension index/value per session, preserving session identifiers. Use to join or pivot custom dimension values into analyses. | Use for: Analyze sessions by custom dimension values; Join custom dimensions to product/hit level analyses; Pivot custom dimension index to columns for modeling
